name: Absen X3v Ground Stack Bar
what: The base beam an LED video wall stands on when it's built up from the floor (ground-stacked) instead of hung from truss.
notes: SUB-RENTAL group: rented from another company when needed. PRICE NOT CONFIRMED (dealer-quote item).

name: Absen X3V Panel
what: One tile of an LED video wall. Dozens lock together into one giant screen. '3.9 mm' is the pixel pitch (distance between LEDs): smaller = sharper up close. Works indoors and outdoors.
specs: 3.91 mm pixel pitch; indoor/outdoor (IP-rated); 500 x 500 mm tile
notes: SUB-RENTAL. PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: LED panels are sold by dealer quote. 40 panels = a large wall.

name: Absen X3V Panel Case
what: Road case that holds several LED panels safely for transport.

name: Absen X3v Stand-Off Pipe
what: Diagonal brace from the ground stack to the back of the LED wall so it can't tip forward or back.

name: Acacia Audio Liz Lav Clothing Clip
ref: Acacia LIZ-LAV Platinum replacement cable & clothing clip
what: The little clip that holds a lav mic onto a shirt, tie or lapel.

name: Acacia Audio LIZ Platinum S8 Lavalier Microphone
ref: Acacia LIZ Platinum lav for Sennheiser wireless
what: A tiny mic clipped to clothing (a 'lav') for presenters and actors. It plugs into a wireless bodypack. 'S8' = the 3.5 mm locking plug that fits Sennheiser packs.
specs: Omnidirectional; S8 connector for Sennheiser bodypacks

name: AC/DC 12V Power Supply
what: Wall plug that turns AC power into 12V DC for small devices (e.g. wireless DMX boxes, LED controllers).
notes: You own 0. PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: generic.

name: Acer Nitro Laptop
what: Show laptop: runs mixer-control software, plays music and walk-in tracks, or records the show.
notes: Exact configuration unknown; priced as a current Nitro V 15.

name: Acer VT0 Touchscreen Monitor
what: Touch display for running software like a lighting or playback app with your fingers.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: couldn't match the model name 'VT0'.

name: ADA Cable Ramps
what: Low, gently sloped covers laid over cable runs so wheelchairs, carts and people can cross safely. ADA = meets accessibility law.

name: Additional Item
what: A placeholder line in the rental system for extra charges or one-off items. Not real gear, nothing to study.

name: ADJ ElectraPix Bar 16
what: 1-meter bar of 16 super-bright LED 'pixels' you can control one by one: chases, wipes and eye-candy effects on stage.
specs: 1 m; 16 individually controlled RGBW pixels; IP-rated

name: ADJ Encore Burst RGBW IP
what: A very bright wide light that 'blinds' the audience for big moments or strobes. Can also wash color. Outdoor-rated.
specs: 150W RGBW COB LED; IP65 outdoor rated; blinder/strobe/wash

name: ADJ Encore Z7LP
what: A PAR is the basic color wash light. This one has 7 LEDs mixing red/green/blue/lime and a motorized zoom, so one light can do a tight beam or a wide wash.
specs: 7 x 20W RGBL; motorized zoom 5-50 degrees; tunable white 2700-7000K; outdoor rated

name: ADJ Encore Z7LP Trunk
what: Road case that holds the Z7LP fixtures (photo shows the foam-cut slots).

name: ADJ Hydro Profile
what: A robotic light that pans and tilts on its own. 'Profile' = it can project sharp shapes (gobos), with shutters to cut the beam. Weatherproof for outdoor shows.
specs: 660W LED; 25,000+ lumens; IP65; gobos, framing shutters, zoom
notes: SUB-RENTAL. Most expensive lighting item so far.

name: ADJ Link Lighting Console
what: A lighting desk with faders and buttons that pairs with an iPad app. Sends DMX to control up to 4 universes (4 x 512 channels) of lights.
specs: 4 DMX universes; 4 x 5-pin DMX out; iPad app (iPad not included)

name: ADJ Scene Setter 24 Ch DMX Dimming Lighting Console
what: A simple 24-fader desk: each fader controls one DMX channel. Good for basic dimmer and wash control and for learning how DMX channels work.

name: ADJ Truss Clamp (Black)
what: Wraps around a truss tube and bolts a light onto it.

name: Adjustable C-Wrench (w/ belt clip)
what: The lighting tech's #1 tool: tightens clamps and yokes on truss. The tether/belt clip stops it from falling on people below.

name: Airport Extreme Base Station
what: A Wi-Fi router that makes a private network so iPads can control the mixers and lights wirelessly.
notes: Discontinued in 2018; $199 was its last retail price. Only sold used now.

name: Airstream DMX Bridge (Lighting)
what: Lets an iPad app control DMX lights over Wi-Fi: the app talks to the Bridge, and the Bridge outputs DMX.
specs: Wi-Fi to 3-pin DMX; works with Airstream iOS app

name: Allen & Heath DX168 Stage Box (16 Input / 8 Output)
what: Digital stage box for Allen & Heath mixers: 16 mic inputs and 8 outputs on stage, connected to the mixer by one network cable.
specs: 16 mic in / 8 out; 96 kHz; DX link (works with SQ, dLive, Avantis)

name: Allen & Heath SQ-7 48-Channel Digital Mixer
what: Your top-tier audio console. A big digital mixer with 33 faders and a touchscreen for concerts, corporate shows and worship.
specs: 48 input channels; 32 onboard mic preamps; 33 faders; 96 kHz; 7" touchscreen
notes: Most expensive owned audio item so far.

name: Alto Stealth Wireless Speaker System Adapter
what: Sends audio from the mixer to powered speakers WITHOUT cables: transmitter at the mixer, receivers at the speakers. Great where you can't run cable across a room.

name: Angler Boombox Light (26")
what: A fabric box that goes over a video light to make it big and soft, so faces look flattering on camera (interviews, headshots).
notes: Price is the softbox only; the light it mounts on isn't included.

name: Antenna Whip
what: Replacement rod antenna for wireless mic receivers. Must match the receiver's frequency band.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: depends on band/brand.

name: APC Smart-UPS C1000 Battery Backup & Surge Protector
what: A rack battery that keeps switchers and computers running for a few minutes if the power blips, so the show doesn't crash.

name: Apple Airport Express Router
what: Small Wi-Fi router for a quick private network (iPad mixer/lighting control).
notes: Discontinued 2018; used only. PRICE NOT CONFIRMED.

name: Apple Express Router Power Supply Cord
what: Replacement power cord for the AirPort Express.

name: Apple iPad (10.9")
what: Used as wireless remotes: mix sound from anywhere in the room (X32/SQ apps), run lighting apps, or check in guests.
notes: Priced as today's base iPad ($449, after June 2026 price change).

name: Apple iPad Mini w/ LTE
what: Small iPad with its own cell data, so it works even without venue Wi-Fi.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: base Wi-Fi model is $599; check Apple for the cellular model's price.

name: Apple Mac Mini (w/ M4 Chip)
what: Small, powerful computer for playback: runs slides (ProPresenter/Keynote), video playback or streaming software, feeding the switcher.
specs: M4 chip; 16GB RAM; 256GB SSD; HDMI + Thunderbolt

name: Applied 12X12 Truss 5' Horizontal
what: Aluminum lattice beam that holds lights, speakers or video. '12x12' = a 12-inch square cross-section. Sections bolt together into longer spans.

name: Applied Electronics PD, 50' 2/0 Feeder Cable, (4) Edison
ref: Applied Electronics power distro with 50' 2/0 feeder
what: A 'distro' takes big power from a generator or building panel (through heavy 2/0 feeder cable) and splits it into normal outlets and circuits for the gear.

name: Applied Electronics PD v2
what: Power distro (see above): splits generator/building power into circuits.

name: Astera AX1 Pixel Tube RGB LED Tube Light
what: Battery-powered LED tube with 16 controllable color pixels, run wirelessly. Popular for film sets, décor and quick uplighting with no cables.
specs: ~1 m tube; 16 pixels; battery; wireless CRMX DMX; IP65

name: AsteraBox Wi-Fi CRMX Transmitter Box
what: The box that talks to Astera lights wirelessly. Control them from the Astera phone app or feed it DMX from a console.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: a search result showed $508.50 but the retailer could not be identified.

name: Asus Monitor 22"
what: Screen for the switcher multiview or the playback computer at the tech table.

name: Audio Technica ATH-M50x Studio Monitoring Headphones
what: Industry-standard closed-back headphones. The engineer uses them to solo and check individual channels without the room noise.
